爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD055 和泉理夏Izumi Rika-耳尖红红
她踮脚替你理领带，指尖似有若无擦过喉结。
退开时仰起脸，睫毛扑闪如蝶翼：“主人……我什么都没做哦。”
无辜极了，可红透的耳尖早就出卖了她。
胸型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink RAD055 Izumi Rika-Red Ear Tips
She tiptoes to adjust your tie, her fingertips lightly brushing your Adam's apple.
As she steps back, she tilts her head back, her eyelashes fluttering like butterfly wings: "Master... I didn't do anything."
She looks utterly innocent, but her bright red ear tips have already given her away.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
